data_audit.source: Preserved Phase 2 Cricsheet IPL JSON, V2-E match-level marts
limitations: info.players entries can include Impact Players and substitutes; recorded participation is not confirmed XI
No non-IPL T20 performances included; no verified player photo license is bundled
Individual matchup small samples can be extremely noisy
Bowler wickets use credited dismissals only, excluding run-outs
Batting average is runs per actual dismissal, not runs per match
Phase breakdowns use regulation deliveries only; no weather/quality adjustment
Awards are linked by verified Cricsheet IDs and are descriptive, not skill metrics

note: Streamlit is not installed in the packaging environment. Final browser visual QA is required on the user machine.
